entries.552210245274ec8f: The company states that the entire group will work together to maintain and strengthen its business base while building a new business structure, formulating a medium-term management plan and planning and promoting specific measures. As a public transport operator, the company names transport safety and the achievement of zero accidents and disasters as its highest priority, and it strengthens safety-related capital investment and employee training; using the framework of the amended Regional Public Transportation Act, it is considering rebuilding regional public transport with high sustainability in cooperation with relevant local governments, and it states that it will promote attracting visitors to Nagatoro, make effective use of real estate in front of stations, and invest in human resources.
